description: Extract clinical mentions (symptoms / risk factors) and their states from free-text describing complaints, mapping them to Infermedica evidence ids (NLP). Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /parse.

age.description: Patient age, e.g. { value: 30 } or { value: 6, unit: 'month' }.

concept_types.description: Restrict captured mentions to these concept types.

context.description: Ordered ids of already-captured present symptoms, used as parsing context.

correct_spelling.description: If true, correct spelling of the input before analysis.

dev_mode.description: If true, mark the request as test traffic → sends the `Dev-Mode: true` header.

include_tokens.description: If true, include tokenization details in the output.

model_id.description: Optional medical model id → sent as the `Model-Id` request header.

name: infermedica_parse
title: Parse clinical text
